<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

function validierung_text(string $wert, int $maximal = 255): string
{
    $wert = trim($wert);
    if (function_exists('mb_substr')) {
        return mb_substr($wert, 0, $maximal);
    }
    return substr($wert, 0, $maximal);
}

function validierung_email(string $email): string
{
    $email = validierung_text($email, 255);
    return filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) ? $email : '';
}

function ausgabe(string $wert): string
{
    return htmlspecialchars($wert, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8');
}

function request_ip_adresse(): string
{
    $remote = validierung_text((string)($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? ''), 80);
    $vertrauenswuerdige_proxies = ['127.0.0.1', '::1', '192.168.178.2'];

    if (in_array($remote, $vertrauenswuerdige_proxies, true)) {
        $weitergeleitet = (string)($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ?? '');
        $kandidaten = array_map('trim', explode(',', $weitergeleitet));
        foreach ($kandidaten as $kandidat) {
            if (filter_var($kandidat, FILTER_VALIDATE_IP)) {
                return validierung_text($kandidat, 80);
            }
        }
    }

    return $remote;
}
